description: This header file defines internal function prototypes for the Slap Owo Uoac component within the SLAP framework, including state management and object wrapper management functions.

methods.name: SlapOwoUoacReset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the Slap Owo Uoac object.

methods.name: SlapOwoUoacAttachObjWrapper
methods.description: Associates an object wrapper with the Slap Owo Uoac object.

methods.name: SlapOwoUoacDetachObjWrapper
methods.description: Detaches an object wrapper from the Slap Owo Uoac object.

methods.name: SlapOwoUoacRemoveObjWrapper
methods.description: Removes an object wrapper from the Slap Owo Uoac object.

methods.name: SlapOwoUoacCleanOwoTable
methods.description: Cleans or resets the internal table within the Slap Owo Uoac object.
